categories.main_business_segments: Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co., Ltd. (1930.T) primarily operates in the equipment construction industry, focusing on electrical, telecommunication, piping, water supply, fire prevention, and civil engineering works. The group also includes subsidiaries engaged in electrical works, piping works, real estate leasing, climbing facility operations, leasing, and PFI projects. The core business is equipment construction, which accounts for the vast majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced construction and engineering techniques, including the development of proprietary systems such as a high-precision GPS-based sag measurement system for transmission lines. It emphasizes safety, quality, and efficiency improvements through technology, and is actively involved in R&D for energy-saving and carbon-neutral construction methods, as well as off-grid solar-powered EV charging solutions in collaboration with academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include electric utilities (notably Hokuriku Electric Power and its group companies), government agencies, and private sector clients in the industrial, commercial, and public infrastructure sectors. The company has a particularly strong relationship with Hokuriku Electric Power, which accounts for a significant portion of its order book, as well as a growing presence in large urban markets and select overseas projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are concentrated in the Hokuriku region of Japan (Toyama, Ishikawa, and Fukui prefectures), with additional branches in Tokyo, Osaka, and other major cities. While the majority of business is domestic, there are some overseas activities, such as solar engineering projects in Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hokuriku Electrical Construction operates as a downstream contractor, providing end-to-end engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services directly to utility companies, government agencies, and private sector clients. It is positioned at the delivery and implementation stage of the supply chain, executing projects and infrastructure installations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share in the Hokuriku region, strengthening operations in metropolitan areas, and exploring new business domains domestically and internationally. The company is committed to sustainability, digital transformation (DX), productivity improvement, and workforce diversity. R&D focuses on safety, quality, efficiency, carbon neutrality, and innovative construction technologies, including renewable energy and disaster resilience.
categories.revenue_model: The company primarily generates revenue through contract-based construction projects, with income recognized upon project completion or according to progress (percentage-of-completion method). Additional revenue streams include real estate leasing, facility management, and other ancillary services provided by subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hokuriku Electrical Construction is a leading regional player in the Hokuriku area and is considered one of the top comprehensive equipment construction firms in the region. Its main competitors are other large general contractors and specialized construction companies, particularly those serving electric utilities and public infrastructure. The company’s close relationship with Hokuriku Electric Power provides a competitive edge in its core market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 55.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.35 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.19 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in both revenue and profit, supported by robust order backlogs and successful M&A activities. Total assets stand at approximately 60.7 billion yen, with a strong equity ratio above 70%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its high technical expertise, safety, and reliability in delivering infrastructure essential to society, particularly in the energy and public works sectors. Its strong regional presence, trusted relationships with major utility clients, commitment to sustainability, and ability to deliver complex, high-quality projects differentiate it from competitors. The focus on innovation, digital transformation, and workforce diversity further enhances its value proposition.
